candidates.candidate: Existing UAR PersistenceConfig and SurrealDB 3.2.4 any engine
candidates.evidence: URL/user/password/ns/db already exist, SDK supports remote and embedded, but UAR signs in as Root only.
candidates.work_required: Add auth scope and reuse existing provider/engine; Boss resolves selected config and reports effective backend. Keep exact current SurrealDB pin.

candidates.candidate: Boss integration operation runner plus existing typed IPC lifecycle
candidates.evidence: Already owns cancellable processes and operation IDs, but tail caps at 262144 and UI polls; no durable cursor/full logs.
candidates.work_required: Durable log/state adapter and ordered events, per-target locks, redaction before persistence, cross-platform process-tree cancellation. No second operation engine.

candidates.evidence: Only checks output_root()/needs_update existence; returns empty success otherwise. Cannot demonstrate source freshness.
candidates.work_required: Do not use as source-drift evidence.

candidates.candidate: Compass detect/Manifest and immutable BuildGuard used by doctor
candidates.evidence: Doctor resolves snapshot, detects corpus, compares manifest hashes; is_unchanged compares added/deleted sets. Existing hashes use mtime shortcut.
candidates.work_required: Expose structured freshness with explicit graph/output and saved extraction config identity. Use complete content checks for requested drift check; report empty/missing/invalid manifests explicitly. Reuse source inclusion/extraction options rather than duplicate scanner.

candidates.candidate: liter-llm provider/model catalogs and ProxyConfig parser/watch
candidates.source: liter-llm schemas/providers.json; schemas/catalog.json; proxy config/mod.rs:426; CLI commands/api.rs
candidates.evidence: providers lists capability metadata; catalog models supply choices; ProxyConfig::from_toml_str validates actual config; --watch exists; CLI currently only Api/Mcp, no nonstarting check command.
candidates.work_required: Package both catalogs from merged fork. Add minimal nonstarting config-check CLI that invokes parser, emits redacted structured errors, and bundle native liter-llm CLI for both customer platforms. Use native binary manager; users require no Rust toolchain.

candidates.evidence: Already available for parse/stringify. Registry latest 1.9.0 dated 2026-09-22; no upgrade needed solely for this feature. Plain stringify does not preserve original comments/layout.
candidates.work_required: Use existing pinned version for read/model conversion only; reject whole-document parse/stringify for external config editing.

candidates.evidence: Rust toml_edit compiled to WASM supports value/delete/array-of-table indexed edits and preserves local decor. Source/tests inspected, not executed. Registry version 0.6.5 modified 2026-03-13.
candidates.work_required: Pin dependency and package WASM as main-process resource. Edit individual fields in selected tables, preserve other sections and environment references. Verify comment preservation and WASM packaged loading in completed Gate C on both platforms, not a standalone prototype suite.

candidates.candidate: Existing mini Compose service runner and Docker Desktop host networking
candidates.evidence: Current compose hardwires memory to ws://surrealdb:8000 and depends_on surrealdb. Desktop documents host.docker.internal; compose --wait waits running/healthy only.
candidates.work_required: Generate selected managed subset and endpoint config, remove dependencies on external DB, translate container-to-host endpoints separately from host clients, preserve loopback port bindings and named volumes. Check accessibility from actual container and distinguish health from auth/application function.

candidates.candidate: Boss SettingsPrimitives, UI package, Preference generator and IPC registries
candidates.source: Boss settingsMenu.ts; routes/settings/prometheus.tsx; scripts/data-classify/README.md; shared/ipc/schemas/prometheus.ts; main/renderer i18n/locales
candidates.evidence: Existing additive registration points and generated Preference definitions. Both locale catalogs have 13 files. Upstream main changed renderer locale files since inspected checkout.
candidates.work_required: Separate feature pages, narrow registration edits, feature-scoped revisioned config updates, generate schemas, translate new keys in both applicable catalogs. No new settings framework.

Catalog provenance/revision snapshots and Boss catalog links.
